assets.prompt: Create an alternate portrait variant of the reference Gen 2 synth. Keep the same face identity, male or female identity, pose, line weight, framing, and transparent background. Make them a Railroad escapee: wear a worn wasteland coat and scarf over the grey Institute suit, remove the Institute logo, keep the visible synthetic seams and ear implant. No glowing eyes, no text, no background.

Create an alternate portrait variant of the reference Gen 3 synth. Keep the same face identity, male or female identity, pose, line weight, framing, and transparent background.
